prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1080; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for side impact collision at intersection. Insured reports the other vehicle entered the intersection against a red signal and struck the driver's side. Police report requested. Photos of both vehicles obtained from insured. Claimant identified as the driver of the striking vehicle. Claimant is represented by counsel; all communication to go through attorney's office.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant's attorney's office. Confirmed representation and requested the medical records, prior treatment history for the lower back, and wage documentation. Advised that liability is under review and no determination has been made. Vehicle inspection scheduled for the insured's vehicle and the claimant's vehicle.

Entry 3: Police report received. Officer noted the claimant's vehicle had a visible damage pattern consistent with the reported impact. Traffic camera footage from the intersection requested from the municipality. Witness statement from a pedestrian obtained and reviewed; witness states the claimant's vehicle did not stop at the signal.

Entry 4: Claimant reports lower back strain from the collision and has been seen at an urgent care facility. Attorney's office submitted an initial treatment summary. Records show diagnosis of lumbar strain, follow-up with physical therapy recommended. Medical review assigned. Reserve adjusted to reflect injury claim pending the full treatment record.

Entry 5: Traffic camera footage received and reviewed. Footage supports the insured's account that the claimant's vehicle entered on a red signal. Liability assessment updated to favor the insured at a high percentage, pending final review by the supervisor. Attorney's office notified that the carrier is evaluating the bodily injury claim and that a settlement position will follow once the physical therapy records are received.
